dedupe_keys.name: a statewide geospatial bridge inspection and vulnerability dataset for florida 1900 2024

description: Segun Ojo and Bradford Johnson at Florida State University publish a bridge-level dataset joining inventory and inspection attributes with traffic, flood exposure and social vulnerability indicators. The statewide collection harmonises public sources, including National Bridge Inventory characteristics, into a common geospatial structure. Zenodo lists a CSV, an Excel data dictionary and a README, free under CC BY 4.0 in the January 2026 release. The title gives 1900–2024, but the public description does not establish whether that span refers to construction dates, observation dates or both; it should not be interpreted as an annual inspection series. The joined asset and exposure variables can support bridge-risk and transport-resilience simulations. Record counts, coordinate precision and missing-data rates remain unknown from the landing page. No related catalogue record is explicitly identified.
